title: Tempstar Furnace Code 1 Flash: Ignition Failure
meaning: One flash indicates failed ignition during the trial period.
snippetAnswer: Tempstar furnace code 1 Flash means One flash indicates failed ignition during the trial period. Most often from worn ignitor. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $150–$450.

title: Tempstar Furnace Code 2 Flash: Pressure Switch Open
meaning: Two flashes mean the pressure switch did not close.
whenToCallPro: Switch or inducer replacement may be needed.
snippetAnswer: Tempstar furnace code 2 Flash means Two flashes mean the pressure switch did not close. Most often from blocked vent. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $175–$900.

title: Tempstar Furnace Code 3 Flash: Limit Switch Open
meaning: Three flashes signal high-limit switch opened.
whenToCallPro: Limit or blower service if repeated.
snippetAnswer: Tempstar furnace code 3 Flash means Three flashes signal high-limit switch opened. Most often from dirty filter. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $150–$600.

title: Tempstar Furnace Code 4 Flash: Rollout Trip
meaning: Four flashes indicate rollout switch opened.
dangerNote: If you smell gas, leave the area and call a technician.
snippetAnswer: Tempstar furnace code 4 Flash means Four flashes indicate rollout switch opened. This is an emergency — do not attempt DIY repairs. Call a licensed technician immediately; typical repairs run $500–$3500.

title: Tempstar Furnace Code 5 Flash: Flame Sense Error
meaning: Five flashes mean flame was not proven.
snippetAnswer: Tempstar furnace code 5 Flash means Five flashes mean flame was not proven. Most often from dirty sensor. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $100–$300.

title: Tempstar Furnace Code 6 Flash: Gas Valve Fault
meaning: Six flashes indicate gas valve circuit error.
dangerNote: If you smell gas, leave the house and call your gas utility before anything else.
snippetAnswer: Tempstar furnace code 6 Flash means Six flashes indicate gas valve circuit error. This is an emergency — do not attempt DIY repairs. Call a licensed technician immediately; typical repairs run $350–$900.

title: Tempstar Furnace Code 7 Flash: Blower Fault
meaning: Seven flashes signal blower motor error.
snippetAnswer: Tempstar furnace code 7 Flash means Seven flashes signal blower motor error. Most often from failed motor. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $450–$1200.

title: Tempstar Furnace Code 8 Flash: Inducer Fault
meaning: Eight flashes indicate inducer motor problem.
snippetAnswer: Tempstar furnace code 8 Flash means Eight flashes indicate inducer motor problem. Most often from seized inducer. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $400–$900.

title: Tempstar Furnace Code 9 Flash: Board Fault
meaning: Nine flashes mean control board internal error.
snippetAnswer: Tempstar furnace code 9 Flash means Nine flashes mean control board internal error. Most often from surge damage. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $300–$800.

title: Tempstar Furnace Code 10 Flash: Low Flame
meaning: Ten flashes indicate weak flame signal.
whenToCallPro: Gas and venting checks if persistent.
snippetAnswer: Tempstar furnace code 10 Flash means Ten flashes indicate weak flame signal. Most often from dirty sensor. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $100–$400.
